narrative:
Perry County has 22,487 registered voters, with 15.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 49.2%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 18.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.5% of registrants.
